turnaround:
Use case: stylized-concept / reference-based character development.
Asset type: polished game character turnaround and expression concept sheet for a future 3D model, not a screenshot of an implemented game.
Input image: supplied YouTube thumbnail is the VISUAL REFERENCE. Develop only the LEFTMOST woman with long black hair and a dark navy headband into one consistent character. Preserve the reference's appealing delicate semi-realistic face, almond-shaped brown eyes, soft natural smile, graceful natural human proportions, and detailed flowing black hair. Do not mix in the other four people.
Primary request: a professionally art-directed high-resolution landscape character model sheet with a light warm gray studio background. Top small restrained title 'CHARACTER STUDY 01', small subtitle 'TURNAROUND / EXPRESSION'. Main left two-thirds: three complete head-to-toe views of the SAME character in a relaxed neutral A-pose, front, exact left profile, and back, all identical height, shoes visible, evenly spaced on a common baseline. Restrained labels 'FRONT', 'SIDE', 'BACK'. Right third: a larger appealing three-quarter head-and-shoulders portrait at the top; beneath it three face closeups of the same character, neutral, warm smile, focused, labeled 'NEUTRAL', 'SMILE', 'FOCUS'.
Style/medium: premium contemporary Korean game character concept rendered with convincing three-dimensional volume, physically believable soft skin, subtle subsurface scattering, detailed layered hair clumps and fine flyaways, soft studio key and fill lighting, clean contact shadows. Semi-realistic stylization matching the thumbnail's beauty and facial proportions. No chibi, no oversized head, no giant doll eyes, no plastic toy look, no stiff primitive geometry, no low-poly shortcuts. Same face, headband, hair length, and body proportions in all views. Every view must be plausibly the same future model.
Costume: retain the reference's neat white short-sleeve collared blouse, dark charcoal/navy plaid necktie and pleated skirt; make the skirt modest above-knee length and blouse opaque, comfortably fitted. Complete the unseen lower legs with simple white ankle socks and clean dark loafers. Natural respectful standing poses, no suggestive posing. Retain dark navy headband. Remove backpack so the silhouette and costume construction are clear.
Composition: spacious elegant studio presentation, very fine pale divider between turnaround and expressions, quiet dark gray typography, no large slogans, no scenery, no bus, no beach, no watermarks, no other characters, no props. Prioritize beautiful face quality and consistency across views rather than adding decorations. This is design artwork only; do not imply a mesh, rig, or GLB exists.

Input image 1: YouTube thumbnail, reference for the FIVE DIFFERENT characters and their left-to-right order. Input image 2: approved first character turnaround, the locked rendering style and first character identity. Expand that visual style to the complete five-person cast.
Primary request: create one polished high-resolution landscape concept sheet, five separate full-length front/very subtle three-quarter character views across the upper 70 percent, with five larger face portraits in five aligned cells across the bottom 30 percent. Match each portrait to the full body above it. Show all heads and shoes without cropping, consistent scale, evenly spaced, no overlapping characters, soft grounding shadows on a clean warm light-gray studio background. Restrained small typography only: title 'RESCENE / CHARACTER LINEUP', and column labels '01', '02', '03', '04', '05'.
Identity order must match the thumbnail:
01: long black softly wavy hair with broad dark navy headband, delicate oval face, warm subtle smile; EXACTLY the first approved turnaround reference.

04: dark hair in two long distinct braids tied with small white ribbon bows, loose face-framing strands and softly parted fringe, gentle eyes and friendly expression. Two braids visible.

Style: match image 2's premium semi-realistic Korean game character concept, convincing three-dimensional volume, beautiful natural faces with subtle individual differences, almond-shaped brown eyes, delicate noses, soft skin, detailed layered hair with fine flyaways, realistic fabric folds and soft studio lighting. Neutral comfortable standing poses with relaxed hands, no suggestive poses, no props or backpacks.
Constraints: exactly five full bodies and exactly five corresponding head-and-shoulders portraits. Retain hair silhouettes and face differences from thumbnail. Remove all thumbnail slogans and backgrounds. No bus, beach, palm tree, extra figures, watermarks, technical claims, UI chrome or excessive decorative text. This is design artwork, not proof of a rig or 3D mesh.
